content:
You can temporarily pause replication if you need to remediate issues or reduce load on the leader
domain. Send this request to the follower domain. Make sure to include an empty request body:
POST _plugins/_replication/follower-01/_pause
{}
Then get the status to ensure that replication is paused:
GET _plugins/_replication/follower-01/_status
{
"status" : "PAUSED",
"reason" : "User initiated",
"leader_alias" : "connection-alias",
"leader_index" : "leader-01",
"follower_index" : "follower-01"
}
When you're done making changes, resume replication. Send this request to the follower domain.
Make sure to include an empty request body:
POST _plugins/_replication/follower-01/_resume
{}
You can't resume replication after it's been paused for more than 12 hours. You must stop
replication, delete the follower index, and restart replication of the leader.

hierarchy.parent: Cross-cluster replication for Amazon OpenSearch Service
